people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
translations.bsb: And this whole land will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
translations.kjv: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
